campaign.name: Aqualyx
campaign.description:
Aqualyx cosmetic is a safe, effective, and painless non-surgical treatment designed to contour targeted areas of the body. With just a few simple sessions, it helps refine and enhance body shape, delivering noticeable results as early as the first two treatments.

Cold chain shipping is used for the international portion

items.name: Aqualyx
items.description:
Aqualyx is a non-surgical, injectable treatment designed to dissolve small, stubborn pockets of localized fat that do not respond to diet and exercise. [1, 2]  

How Aqualyx Works 

• Uses a water-based microgel solution containing deoxycholic acid derivatives. 
• Breaks down fat cell membranes through a process called controlled lysis. 
• Relies on the lymphatic system and natural body waste processes to clear the destroyed fat cells. 
• Requires multiple sessions (typically 2 to 8 treatments spaced several weeks apart) for optimal results. [1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]  

Common Treatment Areas 

• Double chin and jowls 
• Stomach and lower abdomen 
• Outer and inner thighs, including saddlebags 
• Upper arms and knees 
• Hips and flanks (love handles) [1, 6, 8, 9, 10]  

Side Effects and Recovery 

• Common temporary effects: Redness, swelling, bruising, tenderness, and a warm or stinging sensation in the treated area. 
• Downtime: Swelling can last for a couple of weeks, and mild firmness or small lumps may persist for several weeks before resolving. 
• Risks: Rare complications like skin infection or tissue necrosis can occur if administered incorrectly. [2, 10, 11]  

Regulatory Status 

• Holds a CE-mark as a medical device in Europe. 
• Is not FDA-approved in the United States. 
• For safe administration, treatment should only be performed by trained, licensed medical or aesthetic professionals. [2, 3, 4, 10]  

AI responses may include mistakes.
